candidate.name: Rigid Local Systems on Triangle Orbifolds Delta(x, y, z)
candidate.text: Candidate: Representations of the triangle group Delta(x, y, z) into GL_2(F_ell) attached to Beal solutions. Darmon (2000) proved rigid local systems on P^1 \ {0, 1, infty} with monodromy orders x, y, z force the Galois representation to arise from automorphic forms on Shimura curves.

legend.1: level 1: depends on open conjectures (e.g. general Shimura curve modularity over non-totally real fields)
legend.2: level 2: grounded in proved theorems (Darmon 2000, Khare-Wintenberger, Mazur) with concrete lemmas to formalize
legend.3: level 3: complete reduction to exact computable certificates
